adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` the `onError` handler builds `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` which is always a non-empty string (even when `err.data?.code` is `undefined`, it becomes the literal prefix `"undefined: "`). Therefore `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), "error")` will never use the fallback and can display confusing output like `"undefined: ..."` for transport/network errors where `err.data` is absent.
